stories.headline: Govt Mulls ₹20,000 Cr Fund To Power Frontier AI, Compute Ecosystem: Report
stories.summary: The Indian government is considering an anchor investment of ’15,000 crore to ’20,000 crore in a proposed fund dedicated to supporting frontier AI and the compute ecosystem. This initiative aims to build sovereign AI capabilities and strengthen the country's technology infrastructure.

stories.headline: Same failure, better clothes: Matchmade.io on selling Indonesian finance tech in Singapore
stories.summary: Jakarta-based fintech startup Matchmade.io is expanding its automated financial reconciliation software into Singapore. The platform helps corporate finance departments automatically reconcile discrepancies between point-of-sale records and bank statements.
